keyPosePrompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create one production character KEY POSE reference sheet of the exact whale-girl maid in the reference image, on true transparent background. 4 columns x 2 rows, 8 separate full-body poses, large transparent margins, no text/grid. This is a model sheet, NOT redesign. Match original face, blue hair, navy long-sleeved dress, white apron and whale, gold skirt decorations, white frills, shoes and whale tail. Same orthographic camera, same body and head sizes in all 8 cells, identical foot baseline. Maintain original standing proportion, chin around 45% down from hair tuft to soles, not oversized heads.
CRITICAL ANATOMY: Exactly TWO arms, TWO hands, TWO wrist cuffs per character. Every arm has ONE continuous navy sleeve starting at shoulder, passing through elbow, ending at white cuff. Shoulders and upper sleeves are clearly visible IN FRONT of the long hair. Never show disembodied sleeves. When an arm bends upward, the corresponding hip has NO additional hand or white cuff. Keep sleeve and cuff design consistent. Long navy sleeves reach wrists in all poses, no bare forearms.
Top row left to right:
1. Neutral standing, two arms hanging down, two hands beside skirt.
2. Both hands clasped mid-chest, two bent sleeves connected from shoulders to hands. NO hands/cuffs at either hip.
3. Wave with VIEWER LEFT arm raised beside face, elbow clearly bends, right arm down. NO extra left hand/cuff at hip.
4. Thoughtful chin-rest: viewer LEFT hand touches chin with navy sleeve to elbow; other long-sleeved arm folds across waist supporting it. Only two hands, NO lower dangling arms.
Bottom row left to right:
5. Gentle apologetic shallow bow, head tilted forward, both long-sleeved arms bent with hands together over upper apron. Clear shoulder/elbow/wrist continuity, no hip hands.
6. Waiting, head tilted very slightly, both hands together under chin, both arms continuously sleeved, no hip hands.
7. Happy hop preparation: two small fists in front of shoulders, two bent sleeved elbows below fists, slight knee bend. No other hands or cuffs anywhere.
8. Identical neutral standing to cell 1, eyes peacefully closed. Head and body match all other cells.
Every cell one complete character, consistent proportions, crisp clean edges without electric blue halos, no shadows/background/decorations.

animationPrompts.idle:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create a production animation sprite sheet of the EXACT character in this reference, preserving its CORRECT TWO-ARM anatomy, face, head/body ratio, navy LONG sleeves, apron, shoes, tail and blue hair. Do not redesign or change proportions.
Output 4 columns x 4 rows = 16 complete full-body frames, row-major, on a truly TRANSPARENT background. Each cell has equal spacing, empty transparent margins on all sides, fixed camera and same character scale. Remove the reference's cloudy background completely: no cloud, glow, shadow, backdrop or ground. No text, numbers or grid lines.
Exactly two arms and two hands in each frame. Each shoulder joins a CONTINUOUS navy sleeve to its elbow and wrist with a single white cuff. Hair behind the upper arms. No additional hanging sleeves, hands or white cuff at a hip where the arm is raised. No bare forearms. Maintain the skull diameter, torso length, skirt width and leg length in every frame. All subtle motion must come from joint movement, NOT from growing/shrinking body parts. Keep original chibi standing proportions: chin at about 45% of height from highest tuft to soles.
Feet planted on the same local baseline across frames except an intentional jump; sufficient transparent gutters for every whole figure. First and last frames match closely for looping.
Action idle: both arms relaxed down exactly as the reference, with visibly continuous shoulder-to-cuff sleeves. Very gentle breathing and hair sway. Eyes open frames 1-6; half-closed frame7; closed frames8-9; half-open frame10; open frames11-16. No leaning or zoom. Keep shoulders, head, torso and feet registered.
